issue.title: Automatic Plex updates and stale-apt-source alerting on athena
issue.description:
Keep athena's internet-facing packages patched without manual attention, starting with Plex:

- Plex moved its apt repo to `https://repo.plex.tv/deb/ public main` (ed25519 PlexSign.v2 key); the old `downloads.plex.tv/repo/deb` froze at 1.42.2 on 2025-09-22, so athena silently stopped receiving Plex updates for a year and was exploited through bugs fixed in 1.43.3. Gate B of the incident plan switches the source; this task makes updates automatic: add the repo.plex.tv origin to unattended-upgrades (or a scheduled `apt-get install --only-upgrade plexmediaserver` with a service restart), and
- alert when any apt source's `InRelease` list is older than ~7 days or `apt-get update` reports errors (node_exporter textfile collector), so a frozen/rotated repo can never go unnoticed again.

Evidence: research:202610/athena_plex_compromise_incident_report.md ("Bottom line", "Preventing a repeat" #1).

task_type_fields.proposal: Unattended Plex upgrades from repo.plex.tv plus an alert for stale or failing apt sources
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The incident plan only repoints the apt source once; making updates automatic and monitored is separate hardening work.

issue.creation_reason: Athena's Plex stopped receiving updates for a year because its apt repo moved and nothing alerted; the exploited bugs were already patched upstream.

payload.entry: Second live instance found during Gate B (2026-10-17 10:31): apt-get update on athena reports 'OpenPGP signature verification failed: https://cli.github.com/packages stable InRelease ... Missing key 7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325' and silently keeps old index files, so gh (installed 2.100.0) has stopped receiving updates the same way plexmediaserver did. The stale-source alert should treat 'W: ... signature verification' / 'Failed to fetch' on any source as a failure, and the fix here is refreshing the GitHub CLI keyring in /usr/share/keyrings.

Installed unattended-upgrades with /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/20auto-upgrades (APT::Periodic Update-Package-Lists/Unattended-Upgrade "1") and 52athena-unattended-upgrades (upgrade_scope=plex_and_security: origin=Plex Media Server Repository,label=Plex Media Server Repository,site=repo.plex.tv plus the two Debian-Security patterns; Automatic-Reboot false). Collector /usr/local/sbin/athena-apt-source-health (python3 -I) plus athena-apt-source-health.service (Type=oneshot, StateDirectory, ProtectHome/PrivateTmp/ProtectSystem=full/NoNewPrivileges, TimeoutStartSec=30min) and timer OnCalendar=*-*-* 05:15 RandomizedDelaySec=30m Persistent. Rules /etc/prometheus/rules/athena-apt.rules.yml group athena.apt: AthenaAptSourceFailing (consecutive_failures>=2 warning), AthenaAptSourceStale (last success>7d critical), AthenaAptSourceFrozen (InRelease Date>120d for 1h warning), AthenaPlexBehindUpstream (update available>3d warning), AthenaPlexUpstreamCheckFailing (plex.tv check>3d warning), AthenaPlexUpgradeNotApplied (pending Plex origin for 2d warning), AthenaAptHealthCollectorStale (last run>2d or absent for 1h warning). Delivery alert_delivery=email: Alertmanager 127.0.0.1:9093 cluster off, smtp localhost:25 from root@bbugyi.ddns.net to bryanbugyi34@gmail.com send_resolved, Stale inhibits Failing on repo+suite. Gmail 2026-10-17: FIRING AthenaAlertPipelineTest, FIRING AthenaAptSourceStale (cli.github.com), FIRING AthenaRootDiskSpaceWarning (/ ~85%, mailed at once as warned), then RESOLVED AthenaAptSourceStale; alertmanager_notifications_total{integration="email"}=4 and failed_total=0. GitHub CLI keyring replaced with fpr 7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325 (unexpired), old backed up as /etc/apt/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg.expired-2026-09-06. After Gate 2 every athena_apt_source_up=1 and athena_apt_orphan_list_files=0; collector Result=success ExecMainStatus=0. Plex origin proven: is_allowed_origin accepted plexmediaserver candidate 1.43.4.10903-e5521bd8c from repo.plex.tv, and unattended-upgrade --dry-run --debug Allowed origins lists the Plex pattern plus Debian-Security. First unattended run (~06:00-07:00) installs the 7 pending Debian-Security updates (apt_upgrades_pending 1 all + 6 amd64); chrome and gh stay manual. Plex postinst leaves disabled Plex disabled. Timers apt-daily, apt-daily-upgrade, and athena-apt-source-health are scheduled. Config copies in tailnet athena/.
